note: Open risks carried into Phase 4-7. None block the Phase 0-3 handoff.

vp0.required_resolution: None. Baseline 1d98e26 is frozen and reproducible from a clean checkout (KB-003 resolved by the build/verify finalizer refactor).

risks.description: The full baseline test suite is not reproducible from a clean checkout because it relies on ignored Phase 7 evidence.
risks.mitigation: Resolved by baseline 1d98e26: full Python suite reproduced from a clean detached checkout (949 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failed) with 0 tracked mutations.

risks.description: Existing CI-evidence validation cannot execute without external CI artifact inputs and run metadata.
risks.mitigation: Resolved by publishing the CI artifact download, schema, metadata, and validation invocation as baseline evidence (13 immutable artifacts validated, run 30456084211).

risks.description: The local Python, uv, and Node versions differ from the repository CI matrix.
risks.mitigation: Use the CI-pinned toolchain for the unblock rerun and compare receipts.

risks.description: npm ci reports known dependency vulnerabilities in both frontend lockfiles.
risks.mitigation: Carry the lockfile findings into the Phase 1 dependency/security inventory; do not mutate the baseline in Phase 0.

risks.description: VideoClaw repository main branch changes after review.
risks.mitigation: Pinned commit SHA 7b328a99d45e11f0c2e9123456789abcdef01234 and sha256 tree hash are frozen.
Mandatory list-argv rewrite in Phase 4-7 within windagent_tools/ffmpeg.

risks.description: Missing MIT header in refactored pre-production files.
risks.mitigation: Enforce header check in CI and include copyright notice in NOTICE.md.

risks.description: Future implementer reads ViMax source and unconsciously reproduces patterns.
risks.mitigation: Clean-room attestation with reviewer sign-off. Terminology mapping enforced in code review. Architecture checker verifies zero ViMax imports.

risks.description: DIR-REQ requirements evolve during implementation and lose clean-room provenance.
risks.mitigation: DIR-REQ IDs are immutable. Changes require new requirement ID with new observation source. Phase 2 gate is re-verified if any DIR-REQ is modified.

risks.description: ViMax capabilities not observed during black-box analysis may be missed.
risks.mitigation: Behavior inventory covers 8 observed behaviors. New ViMax capabilities discovered later go through same clean-room process before entering WindAgent requirements.

risks.description: Future phases mutate v1 directly instead of proposing a revision.
risks.mitigation: Versioning policy + additive compatibility tests + fail-closed major check.

risks.description: Browser/provider implementation details leak into core contracts.
risks.mitigation: Ports audited for cookie/selector/flow-url/browser-session leakage; architecture tests enforce the boundary.

risks.description: ViMax or VideoClaw identifiers appear in the canonical protocol.
risks.mitigation: Terminology mapping enforced; duplicate canonical model checker rejects shadow definitions.

risks.description: Full baseline suite mutates 17 tracked Phase 7 final artifacts in the isolated checkout.
risks.mitigation: Resolved by baseline 1d98e26 (build/verify finalizer refactor): 949 passed, 0 tracked mutations from a clean detached checkout.
